# Bellows (Accordion 03) Task Outline & Design Notes

- **Source:** ColorLib Accordion 03 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/accordion-03/`)
- **New Name:** Bellows (`apps/bellows`)
- **Design Category:** UI Component / Accordion Showcase

## Tasks

1. Scaffold `apps/bellows` with Vite + React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + TypeScript.
2. Register workspace in root `package.json` and run `npm install`.
3. Create `Navbar`, `Hero`, `AccordionSection`, and `Footer` components.
4. Implement interactive accordion state and styling matching clean Bootstrap accordion aesthetics.
5. Add comprehensive unit tests with Vitest + Testing Library achieving 100% coverage.
6. Verify build, typecheck, lint, and test coverage.
7. Deploy / register CNAME (`bellows.free.componentdock.com`).
